title: USDA's FoodData Central: what is it and why is it needed today?
authors: Fukagawa NK, McKillop K, Pehrsson PR, Moshfegh A, Harnly J, Finley J
funder: All authors are employed by the USDA Agricultural Research Service and have not received external support in the preparation of this manuscript.
authorConflicts: The authors report no conflicts of interest.
result: FoodData Central SR Legacy entries read on 2026-10-21. Egg, whole, raw, fresh (FDC 171287), per 100 g: water 76.2 g; energy 143 kcal; protein 12.6 g; total fat 9.51 g; saturated fatty acids 3.13 g; cholesterol 372 mg (12 data points, 344 to 405); total choline 294 mg (6 data points, 280 to 307); lutein + zeaxanthin 503 µg (6 data points, 431 to 575); portion weight of a large egg 50 g. Egg, yolk, raw, fresh (FDC 172184), per 100 g: total fat 26.5 g; cholesterol 1080 mg; total choline 820 mg; lutein + zeaxanthin 1090 µg; a large yolk weighs 17 g. Egg, white, raw, fresh (FDC 172183), per 100 g: water 87.6 g; protein 10.9 g; total fat 0.17 g; cholesterol 0 mg; total choline 1.1 mg; lutein + zeaxanthin 0 µg; a large white weighs 33 g. For a 50 g large egg the whole-egg values correspond to 186 mg cholesterol and 147 mg choline. SR Legacy, released in April 2018, is the final release of that data type.
